title: baguette belongs on your radar
description:
tddworks/baguette is the kind of repo that can quietly upgrade a developer workflow. Headless iOS Simulator manager/farm + host-side input injection for iOS 26 — taps, swipes, multi-finger gestures, and 60 fps streaming. It has about 909 GitHub stars, and it is active enough to deserve a closer look. Save this for your next build, and follow for more useful developer tools.

https://github.com/tddworks/baguette
